#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
RUN=$(< /tmp/hipengine-flashnext-release-current-path)
PY="$HOME/miniforge3/envs/therock/bin/python"
SDK=$("$PY" -m rocm_sdk path --root)
SITE=$("$PY" -c 'import site; print(site.getsitepackages()[0])')
export RUN
exec env -i HOME="$HOME" USER="${USER:-lhl}" LOGNAME="${LOGNAME:-lhl}" SHELL=/bin/bash TERM=xterm \
  PATH="$(dirname "$PY"):$SDK/bin:$SDK/lib/llvm/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" \
  LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$SITE/_rocm_sdk_core/lib:$SITE/_rocm_sdk_devel/lib:$SITE/_rocm_sdk_libraries/lib" \
  HIP_PATH="$SDK" ROCM_PATH="$SDK" HIP_LIB_PATH="$SDK/lib" HIP_INCLUDE_PATH="$SDK/include" \
  HIP_DEVICE_LIB_PATH="$SDK/lib/llvm/amdgcn/bitcode" HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 \
  HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE="$RUN/hipcc-version.txt" PYTHONPATH="$RUN/source" \
  RUN="$RUN" "$PY" "$@"
launch_context.benchmark_job:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
RUN=$(< /tmp/hipengine-flashnext-release-current-path)
cd "$RUN/source"
exec 9>/tmp/hipengine-gfx1151-benchmark.lock
flock -n 9 || { printf 'gfx1151 benchmark lock is held\n' >&2; exit 2; }
MODEL="$HOME/models/gguf/unsloth-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-UD-Q4_K_XL/UD-Q4_K_XL"
SIDECAR="$HOME/models/gguf/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MTP-Q8_0/mtp-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Q8_0.gguf"
py() { bash /tmp/hipengine-flashnext-release-python.sh "$@"; }
run() {
  local name=$1
  shift
  printf '[start] %s %s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$name"
  printf '%q ' "$@" >> "$RUN/commands.txt"; printf '\n' >> "$RUN/commands.txt"
  "$@" > "$RUN/$name.log" 2>&1
  printf '[done] %s %s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$name"
}
run prebuild-all py scripts/qwen4exp_canonical_ar_bench.py hipengine --model-root "$MODEL" --output "$RUN/prebuild-all.json" --prefill-chunk-size 4096 --capture-mode compact --ple-cache-mode warm --execution-profile production --warmups 0 --repetitions 1 --compiler-version-file "$RUN/hipcc-version.txt"
run canonical py scripts/qwen4exp_canonical_ar_bench.py hipengine --model-root "$MODEL" --output "$RUN/canonical-ar.json" --prefill-chunk-size 4096 --capture-mode compact --ple-cache-mode warm --execution-profile production --warmups 1 --repetitions 3 --compiler-version-file "$RUN/hipcc-version.txt" --require-cached-build
for rep in 1 2; do
  run "mtp-suite-$rep" py scripts/qwen4exp_mtp_inprocess_bench.py --model-root "$MODEL" --sidecar "$SIDECAR" --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --max-tokens 64 --budget 3 --execution-profile production --output "$RUN/mtp-suite-$rep.json"
done
run mtp-heldouts py scripts/qwen4exp_mtp_inprocess_bench.py --model-root "$MODEL" --sidecar "$SIDECAR" --prompts benchmarks/prompts/gdn-prefill-category-heldouts.jsonl --max-tokens 64 --budget 3 --execution-profile production --output "$RUN/mtp-heldouts.json"
printf '[complete] Flash-Next canonical and MTP runs\n'
launch_context.public_api_probe:
"""Confirm Flash-Next plain and MTP generation through the public API."""
from dataclasses import asdict, is_dataclass
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from hipengine import LLM, SamplingParams

run = Path(os.environ["RUN"])
model = Path.home() / "models/gguf/unsloth-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-UD-Q4_K_XL/UD-Q4_K_XL"
sidecar = Path.home() / "models/gguf/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MTP-Q8_0/mtp-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Q8_0.gguf"
fixture = json.loads(Path("benchmarks/fixtures/qwen4exp_canonical_ar_p512_p1024_p4096.json").read_text())
case = next(c for c in fixture["cases"] if c["id"] == "code-p512")
llm = LLM(str(model), max_sequence_length=4096, max_active_requests=1,
          draft_model=str(sidecar), speculative_candidate_budget=3)
rows = []
try:
    prompt = case["prompt_token_ids"]
    for mtp in (False, True):
        params = SamplingParams(max_tokens=64, temperature=0.0, ignore_eos=True,
                                speculative_mtp=mtp)
        text = llm.generate([prompt], params)[0]
        output = llm.generate_detailed([prompt], params)[0]
        assert text == output.text
        assert len(output.generated_token_ids) == 64
        assert output.text.strip()
        telemetry = getattr(output, "telemetry", None)
        if mtp:
            assert telemetry is not None
        rows.append({"mtp_requested": mtp, "text": text,
                     "generated_token_ids": list(output.generated_token_ids),
                     "finish_details": asdict(output.finish_details),
                     "telemetry": asdict(telemetry) if is_dataclass(telemetry) else repr(telemetry)})
    canonical = json.loads((run / "canonical-ar.json").read_text())
    oracle = next(s for s in canonical["samples"] if s["case_id"] == "code-p512")
    assert rows[0]["generated_token_ids"] == oracle["output_token_ids"][:64]
    resolved = llm._resolved_execution_profile
    result = {"schema": 1, "kind": "flashnext_public_api_confirmation", "passed": True,
              "backend": llm._resolved_backend, "quant": llm._resolved_quant,
              "manifest_sha256": getattr(resolved, "manifest_sha256", None),
              "rows": rows, "canonical_plain_ids_match": True}
finally:
    llm.close()
(run / "public-api.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, default=str) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in result.items() if k != "rows"}))
